mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand_dispatch ( demand_id, supplier_id, supplier_name, hr_user_id, hr_user_name, receive_status, dispatch_time, receive_time, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time ) VALUES ( #{demandId}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{hrUserId}, #{hrUserName}, #{receiveStatus}, #{dispatchTime}, #{receiveTime}, #{createUserId}, #{createUserName}, #{createTime}, #{updateUserId}, #{updateUserName}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM demand_dispatch WHERE demand_id = #{demandId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.update: UPDATE demand_dispatch SET receive_status = #{receiveStatus}, receive_time = NOW(), update_user_id = #{operatorUserId}, update_user_name = #{operatorUserName}, update_time = NOW() WHERE demand_id = #{demandId} AND hr_user_id = #{hrUserId} AND receive_status != 'ACCEPTED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM demand_dispatch WHERE demand_id = #{demandId} AND hr_user_id = #{hrUserId}
